originals.citation: Zhou, B., Wei, F.-Y., et al. (2014). Identification of a splicing variant that regulates type 2 diabetes risk factor CDKAL1 level by a coding-independent mechanism in human. Human Molecular Genetics.

quote: A strong correlation between risk alleles and lower levels of the non-coding RNA, CDKAL1-v1, has recently been reported in whole blood extracted from Japanese individuals. We sought to replicate this association
notes: Zhou 2014 (co-authors Wei, Tomizawa) reported CDKAL1-v1 and its association with risk SNPs in Japanese whole blood. DOI not verified.
